newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3915/3.3939 to the dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3915/3.3939 to the dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3900 and 3.3930 pounds bid to 3.3910 and 3.3970 pounds offered in the interbank market on Thursday.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3915 pounds bid and 3.3939 pounds offered. The averages compared to 3.3900 pounds bid and 3.3925 offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at the midday as 3.388504 buy and 3.397390 sell.
